conflicts.text: Sources disagree on held percent insiders: 45.283 (yfinance (heldPercentInsiders)) vs 38.6 (NSE shareholding filing) — The provider's heldPercentInsiders (45.28%) counts INSIDERS — a superset that mixes promoter-group holders with other insider rows and can carry stale, individually-dated as-of dates — while the NSE shareholding filing reports the strict PROMOTER GROUP at 38.60% as of 2026-06-30.
